_comment: Single source of truth for the TBox power tree. tools/gen_power_tree.py regenerates the schematic tree graphic and per-stage load annotations in kicad/supply.kicad_sch from this file. Do not hand-edit the generated block in the schematic. Per-node max_ma/max_basis is the supply's deliverable maximum (rated current, or the thermal limit where that binds first); _max_analysis records the derivation and is not drawn. alert_utilization is the fraction of max_ma at which tools/check_power.py (TODO) should alert.

input.name: 13V8_IN
input.note: PTC 0.5A hold vs ~250 mA worst-case draw; SMBJ18A TVS after the filter (regulator max 35 V)

nodes.name: RAW_13V8
nodes._max_analysis: No conversion stage; capability is the input PTC hold current, shared with everything downstream (incl. LM2940 input current).

loads.name: LED rail (7 LEDs incl. 17 mA TX lamp)

nodes.name: +9V
nodes._max_analysis: Rated 1A but package-Pd-limited: Tj 125C, Ta 50C, thetaJA 32.5 C/W (RGW VQFN-20 with thermal pad on a ground pour, VERIFY against layout) -> Pd 2.3W; at 15V in (6V drop) I <= 385 mA. At 13.8V in ~480 mA (PTC 0.5A then binds).
nodes.note: Pd 1.0W @13V8, 1.2W @15V worst case; dropout 0.22 V -> OK to 10V5 in
nodes.sch_note:
load 70 mA typ / 205 mA max
Pd <=1.2W @15V; dropout OK to 10V5

loads.name: TX bus (U401/U402/U403: sum, mic out, line L/R)

nodes.name: BIAS_5V
nodes._max_analysis: ADP7142AUJZ-5.0 rated 200 mA. Thermal is non-binding at this load: 9V in, 4V drop, load 1-2 mA -> Pd ~8 mW, negligible in TSOT-23-5 (thetaJA ~170C/W). Rating binds far above the ~2 mA budget.

nodes.name: VREF
nodes._max_analysis: NE5532 output: ~38 mA short-circuit typ; ~10 mA is a sane continuous drive limit for an AC ground reference.
